title: org.prodid.feed
description: Discovery document served at /.well-known/prodid.json. The source identity is the domain it speaks for, which is the domain serving it unless the document was reached through a _prodid DNS TXT record.

domain.description: The domain this document speaks for. Required, and equal to the delegating domain, whenever the document is reached through a _prodid TXT record naming a host other than the domain itself; a delegated document without it is rejected. It may be absent only when the domain serves the document itself. A document naming a domain that does not delegate to this host speaks for nobody and is ignored. Lowercase hostname: labels and dots, at least two labels, no scheme, no port, no path, never an IP literal.

license.description: SPDX license identifier covering the facts in the feeds.

feeds.description: NDJSON files, one org.prodid.item record per line. Every feed must be served from the same host as the discovery document; a document listing a feed on any other host, or more than 100 of them, is rejected whole.
